checkerSource: function checkCuts(C,cuts){let counts={rows:0,pairs:0};const key=q=>[...new Set(q)].sort((a,b)=>a-b).join(",");for(let z of cuts){const lookup=new Set;for(let i of z.clauseIds){if(!Number.isInteger(i)||i<1||i>C.length)throw Error("row index");lookup.add(key(C[i-1]));counts.rows++}let A=new Map,B=new Map;if(z.demands.length<=z.resources.length)throw Error("not deficient");for(let i=0;i<z.demands.length;i++){let row=z.demands[i];if(!lookup.has(key(row)))throw Error("missing demand");for(let l of row){if(A.has(l))throw Error("overlapping demand");A.set(l,i)}}for(let i=0;i<z.resources.length;i++){let row=z.resources[i];for(let l of row){if(B.has(l))throw Error("overlapping resource");B.set(l,i)}for(let a=0;a<row.length;a++)for(let b=a+1;b<row.length;b++){let x=row[a],y=row[b];if(!A.has(x)||!A.has(y)||A.get(x)===A.get(y))continue;counts.pairs++;if(x!==-y&&!lookup.has(key([-x,-y])))throw Error("missing cross conflict")}}if(key([...A.keys()].filter(l=>!B.has(l)))!==key(z.clause))throw Error("incorrect boundary");}return counts}
scope: Necessary constraints only; equality can be contracted in native parity DSU, retaining source reconstruction. No universal UCAC.
